items.statement: A source-bounded evidence-supported answer to: How does replacing the specified internal carbon sites by BN units affect the low-energy molecular electronic excitations of BN-AkFlu and CC-AkFlu, and what molecular explanation can be supported? Determine which differences are robust and which depend on the chosen model or state interpretation.
items.expected: Accept scientifically defensible alternative methods and evidence-supported support, refutation or unresolved answers. Judge sufficiency for the actual question and claims; do not require any retired V1 matrix, author winner, fixed hypothesis count or particular software. Full points require linked genuine artifacts that sustain the claim; partial points scale with valid question coverage; absent/invalid evidence receives zero dependent credit. Missing research cannot establish non-identifiability. Conclusions cover these finite molecules and their low-energy electronic excitations. A vertical excitation or frontier orbital gap does not determine emission yield, nonradiative rate, solid packing or charge mobility. Do not extrapolate to other BN derivatives or a device.
